The Dutch Development Economics Network is launching a new website!

This is where you will find our upcoming and past [events](../../../events/index.qmd), the [universities](../../../members/universities/index.qmd) and [members](../../../members/members/index.qmd) that make up the network and, here on the blog, news and ideas from across our community.

![Members of the network at one of our workshops.](welcome.jpg){fig-alt="Members of the network gathered for a group photo at a workshop"}

We look forward to the many contributions of knowledge and thought from our members. Have something to share? [Get in touch](#contact) and write a post for the blog.
